content.short: Quay is a backend API that enables NFT marketplaces to be built using trusted Seaport contracts.
content.description: Quay offers a turnkey backend API for developers to quickly and securely launch an NFT marketplace powered by Seaport contracts. Implemented in Rust, it delivers a high-performance, production-ready backend you can integrate into your platform. With Quay, orderbook-based NFT marketplaces can support ERC 721, ERC 1551, and ERC 20 token standards on any blockchain that uses an Ethereum Virtual Machine, making it adaptable to a wide range of networks. The solution emphasizes reliability, modularity, and scalability for complex trading experiences.
